items.title: 31.3 X-ray crystallography aur banawat ka tajziya (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of X-ray crystallography (PDF 223-224).

blocks.text: X-ray crystallography aik bohat taqatwar analytical tool (jaanch ka auzaar) hai jis se crystalline solid (ba-qaida tarteeb wale thos) mein atoms ki three-dimensional (3D) jagahein maloom ki jati hain. Yeh material science, biochemistry aur pharmaceutical (dawaon ki) chemistry mein ahem hai, kyunke is se scientists materials ki structure (banawat) dekh sakte hain.

X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti hoti hai. Is liye yeh electromagnetic radiation kisi molecule ya ionic compound mein electrons aur atoms ki jagah maloom karne ke kaam aati hai. Solid materials atoms ki layers (tahon) ya strands (lariyon) se bane hote hain.
Jab source se X-rays crystal par parti hain to atoms se takra kar khaas angles (zawiyon) par diffract hoti hain (mur jati hain), jaisa Figure 31.4 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Do mutawazi aane wali X-rays (teer) surkh atoms ki qataaron mein aik doosre ke oopar neeche, d faasle par, do atoms se takrati hain aur qataaron se usi zawiye theta par diffracted X-rays ban kar nikalti hain. Oopar wale atom se gulabi amood neeche wali ray par atom se pehle aur baad d sin theta kaat'te hain; oopar wale atom par theta aur neeche wale par 2 theta. Diffracted rays ke saath gulabi bracket par '2d sin theta = total path length difference'.
blocks.caption: Figure 31.4: X-ray diffraction (kitab ki Figure 31.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 31.4 mein daen taraf 'Different X-rays' chhapa hai; sahi lafz 'Diffracted X-rays' hai, kyunke kitab ka apna matan kehta hai ke X-rays atoms se takra kar diffract hoti hain. Neeche wali tah se lautne wali ray ko oopar wali ray se 'd sin theta' aate hue aur 'd sin theta' jaate hue zyada rasta tay karna parta hai, yani kul izafi rasta 2d sin theta. Jab yeh izafi rasta wavelength ka poora guna ho to rays aik doosre ko mazboot karti hain aur screen par roshan nuqta banta hai.

Yeh diffracted rays screen par patterns banati hain jinhein diffraction patterns kehte hain. Diffraction pattern molecule mein atoms aur electrons ki jagah batata hai. Is se naqshe (maps) bante hain aur atoms ke darmiyan faasla maloom hota hai. Mathematical models aur pattern ke analysis ki madad se scientists crystal mein atoms ki jagahon aur bond angles ka poora naqsha bana lete hain. Yun atoms aur un ki electron density (electrons kahan zyada hain) ka mukammal naqsha ban jata hai aur molecule ya crystal ki poori structure maloom ho jati hai. Naphthalene molecule ki structure Figure 31.5 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: naphthalene ka electron-density contour naqsha: mota bahari contour jis mein hydrogen atoms ki jagah ubhaar hain, rings ke beech do chhe-kone khali hisse, aur das carbon atoms par tah-dar gol contours; leader lines 500 (andar aur bahar), 1000 aur 2000 dikhati hain. Daen: naphthalene ki banawat, do jure chhe-rukni rings (andar daire), das C aur aath H atoms.
blocks.caption: Figure 31.5: Naphthalene molecule ka diffraction pattern (kitab ki Figure 31.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen naqsha batata hai ke molecule mein electrons kahan zyada hain: har gol tah-dar nishan aik carbon atom hai (beech mein sab se ghana, 2000 se zyada), aur bahari ubhaar hydrogen atoms hain jin ke paas electrons kam hain (sirf 500 wala contour). Rings ke beech khali hisse mein electron density kam hai. Is naqshe se atoms ki jagahein naap kar daen wali banawat banayi jati hai.

XRD ka sab se mashhoor istemal DNA ki double helix structure maloom karna hai. X-ray crystallography aaj bhi enzymes aur proteins jaise pecheeda biomolecules ki jaanch mein kaam aati hai. Yeh nayi dawaon (drugs) ki tayyari mein bhi use hoti hai: designers is se dekhte hain ke dawa ka molecule apne target se kaise jurta hai. Aik aur istemal materials aur minerals ki jaanch hai: minerals, synthetic crystals aur nanomaterials ka analysis. Is se electronics, optics aur construction mein materials ki performance behtar hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Crystal mein atoms ki jagah maloom karne ke liye X-rays kyun use hoti hain, aam roshni (visible light) kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti hai, taqreeban atoms ke darmiyani faasle jitni, is liye atoms ki layers inhein diffract karti hain. Aam roshni ki wavelength bohat lambi hai, us se yeh pattern nahi banta.

blocks.prompt: X-ray crystallography ke do istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: DNA ki double helix structure; enzymes aur proteins ki jaanch; dawaon ki tayyari; minerals, synthetic crystals aur nanomaterials ka analysis.

items: XRD crystalline solid mein atoms ki 3D jagahein maloom karta hai.
Diffracted X-rays diffraction pattern banati hain; is se electron density ka naqsha banta hai.
Istemal: DNA, enzymes aur proteins, dawayein, minerals aur nanomaterials.
